notes: Operator official page confirms Brazzaville datacenter: 'TIER III Datacenter compliant with international best practices', colocation (rack/half-rack), sovereign cloud, DRP/BCP, 24/7 monitoring and access control, local Brazzaville support. ST Digital positions itself as first neutral independent Tier 3 operator in Central/West Africa (sites: Douala, Abidjan, Libreville, Lome, Brazzaville, Kinshasa). Uptime certification not verified; capacity not published.
